title: School Notebooks 5-pack

drivers.name: Price increase (6.0% above regular)
drivers.evidence: Price increase to $8.83; past weeks at this price show mixed results (28 units, then 7). No promotion at this price. Noise-adjusted effect of past promotions is x1.0. Price increases reduce demand. Shrink toward 1.0.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 12.1. The price is raised 6.0% to $8.83, which is above regular price. Recent weeks show that at $8.83, sales were 28 (4/6) and 7 (4/13), with no event. The 4/6 spike (x2.31 vs baseline) likely reflects Easter. The 4/13 dip (x0.58) may be post-promotion or noise. No prior promotion at this price level. The noise-adjusted lift from past 10% discounts is x1.0 (no signal). Price increases typically reduce demand; no evidence of price elasticity here. The classical model suggests no uplift, consistent with weak evidence. The price hike likely suppresses demand. Shrink toward 1.0 due to thin evidence and high noise. No event or promotion.
